assumptions.LED_static_source: Lin et al.2026 / Zenodo10.5281/zenodo.20034288;20um square yellow InGaN on diamond; source temperature unspecified
assumptions.C_status: constant parallel capacitance sensitivity assumption, not measured device capacitance
assumptions.driver_parameters: Original matched-r2 TT single calibration, no new fitting or per-corner tuning
assumptions.RX: Frozen v2 historical result only here; independent dynamic-family offline analysis consumes identical conduction current
assumptions.energy: Native seven-port source power -V*I; positive delivered, returned magnitude and signed net separately; divide full-frame energy by4096 attempted payload bits. No RX/sourceIC/host/clock internal energy.
assumptions.physical_level: New schematic transistor simulation only, no inherited layout/PEX/silicon/optical qualification

proxy.input: LED conduction current only; displacement excluded by harness

sampling.training_selection: Maximize minimum signed expected-class threshold distance in absoluteuA. Among candidates within1pA of maximum, maximize minimum TRAINING absolute time margin; earliest exact tie wins. Validation never participates.

horizontal_margin.definition: Minimum one-sided shift from frozen training sample to either correct decision-region threshold crossing across validation. Linear interpolation on original RX time grid; wrong/on-threshold samples have0 margin. No refit and no UI normalization for100ps acceptance.
